metadata.review_notes: Verified against official DC-MSME Gazette Guidelines 2024. All 4 rules and capex formulas validated.

scheme_name: Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme for Technology Upgradation (CLCSS)
authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises, Government of India
objective: Aims at facilitating technology up-gradation by providing 15% upfront capital subsidy to MSEs on institutional finance availed for induction of well-established and approved technologies in specified sub-sectors.
exclusions: Medium enterprises having investment in plant & machinery exceeding ₹10 Crore
Units purchasing second-hand or refurbished machinery
Activities included in statutory negative list

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Ineligible: Medium enterprises are barred from CLCSS assistance. The scheme is statutory restricted to Micro and Small units.

evidence.exact_quote: The scheme covers Micro and Small Enterprises having valid Udyam Registration engaged in manufacturing.

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Ineligible: Enterprise must be engaged in tangible manufacturing with identifiable technology induction.

evidence.exact_quote: Assistance is available for approved manufacturing sub-sectors only. Pure commercial trading and services are strictly ineligible.

eligibility_rules.failure_message: Ineligible: Enterprise accounts classified as Non-Performing Assets (NPA) cannot receive central interest or capital subsidies.

evidence.exact_quote: Term loans sanctioned by Primary Lending Institutions must be standard assets with no overdue NPA history.
The ceiling on eligible loan amount for calculation of subsidy is ₹100 Lakh.

registration_requirements.verification_method: API verification via Udyam Certificate Number

prerequisites: Valid Udyam Registration Certificate under Micro or Small category.
Institutional term loan sanction from a scheduled commercial bank or approved PLI.
Pro-forma invoice detailing OEM technical specifications for new machinery.
required_documents: Audited Financial Statements for preceding 3 financial years
Bank Term Loan In-Principle Sanction Letter
Machine Manufacturer Pro-forma Invoice and Technical Specifications

evidence.exact_quote: Upfront capital subsidy of 15% shall be calculated on the eligible investment in plant and machinery up to a ceiling of ₹100 Lakh (Maximum Subsidy ₹15 Lakh).

possible_relationships.target_scheme_name: Credit Guarantee Scheme for Micro & Small Enterprises
possible_relationships.description: CLCSS subsidy can be combined with CGTMSE credit guarantee on the balance loan component without conflict.
possible_relationships.statutory_non_duplication_clause: CGTMSE Operational Circular 112/2023: 'Guarantee coverage may be extended to term loans sanctioned under government capital subsidy programs including CLCSS.'

evidence.exact_quote: Guarantee coverage may be extended to term loans sanctioned under government capital subsidy programs including CLCSS.

application_process:
1. Enterprise prepares project report and approaches Primary Lending Institution (PLI).
2. Bank appraises project and sanctions term loan.
3. Bank submits online subsidy claim on official portal (clcss.dcmsme.gov.in) to SIDBI/NABARD.
4. Nodal agency releases subsidy into beneficiary loan account subject to 3-year asset lock-in.

source_documents.issuing_authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
source_documents.exact_quote: Guidelines for Implementation of Credit Linked Capital Subsidy Scheme for Technology Upgradation of Micro and Small Enterprises.
